Luminosity Gaming is a Canadian esports organization based in Toronto, Canada founded in February 2015 by Steve Maida. After operating independently from 2015 to 2019, on September 3rd, 2019 the organization was acquired by Enthusiast Gaming. [1] It was later reacquired by Steve Maida on January 16th, 2026, with the organziation entering Counter-Strike 2 on July 1st, 2026. [2]

  • August 24th - Luminosity Gaming bench Bymas. [30]
  • August 25th - Luminosity Gaming acquire kakafu and yxngstxr from Monte and HEROIC, respectively, the former as their new coach. [31][32]
